data.name: Sachin
data.gender_notes: Sachin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sach’ meaning ‘true’ or ‘real’, and ‘chit’ meaning ‘knowledge’. In Hindu mythology, the name Sachin is believed to represent the divine, the anointed, and the able. The name is associated with the god Vishnu, who is known to be the preserver of the universe and the embodiment of truth and knowledge.
data.etymology: Sachin belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine, Anointed, Able.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sachin total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sachin has been significant in various industries and fields, most notably in cricket. Sachin Tendulkar, one of the greatest cricketers of all time, carries this name. He is considered a god in Indian cricket culture and has left an indelible mark on the sport. The name Sachin represents qualities of greatness, determination, and resilience, which are highly valued in Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sachin holds a deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It reflects the Hindu emphasis on seeking and living a life rooted in truth and knowledge. The name is believed to reflect the divine qualities of Vishnu and serves as a reminder to the individual to strive towards becoming a truthful, compassionate, and knowledgeable individual, embodying the principles of dharma, artha, kama, and moksha. In Hindu astrology, the name Sachin is believed to bring good fortune and blessings.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sachin signifies truth and purity. It is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sat', meaning 'truth'. For a Sachin, every action is an expression of truth and honesty. This name resonates with the spirit of remaining steadfast in one's beliefs and values.

vedic_reference.note: In Hinduism, 'Sachin' is the name of a legendary king and a popular god. It is also mentioned in various Vedic texts, including the Rigveda (1.17.12).

historical_references.reference: Sachin Tendulkar, the legendary cricket player, is believed to have originated from the ancient Indian city of Devagiri (Daulatabad), which was a significant political and cultural center during the Deccan Sultanate period.

trends: First Indian to score a double century in ODI
modern_usage.modern_context: Sachin Tendulkar is widely regarded as one of the greatest cricket players of all time. He has numerous records in both Test and One-Day International cricket, and is the first Indian to score a double century in ODI cricket.
